name: 93730 · Fresno, CA
findings: ZIP 93730 (Fresno) has 33 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 93730 (Fresno) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 93730 (Fresno) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 28% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 29 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
